qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Complex multimetal smelting and recycling infrastructure provides technological processing scale, but treatment charges (TC/RCs) and metal premia are dictated by global benchmark negotiations and Chinese smelting capacity, leaving Aurubis as a margin taker without pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12% & price-taker economics, REJECT). Aurubis operates Europe's largest copper smelting and recycling network, but earnings are fundamentally constrained by global treatment and refining charges (TC/RCs), scrap spreads, and volatile energy costs. Multi-cycle GAAP ROIC hovers around 8-10%, failing the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: Historical ROCE/ROIC averages 8-10% across the cycle. Thin net margins (3-5%) fluctuate with global TC/RC benchmarks, byproduct acid prices, and energy costs. Inability to set prices independently of global commodity and smelting dynamics demonstrates lack of pricing power.
